metadata.description: Major Tom harness marketplace: AI-agentic SDLC harness for any project, dual-published for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI (Copilot reads this same file).

plugins.name: major-tom
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: two-stage onboard workflow (repo scan, interview in the session, execute), strict config schema for .claude/major-tom.json, specialist agent roster, .knowledge/ persistence, an operator writing-rule hook, and a think skill with a mechanical intent gate. Install this one in Claude Code.

plugins.name: major-tom-copilot
plugins.description: GitHub Copilot CLI variant, derived from the same template source as the Claude Code plugin, never authored apart. Currently ships the agent roster; further surfaces land as they are derived. Install this one with `copilot plugin install`.
